segments.text: This is the route you would have to take
if you want to go to a high school near
Mexico City, a 45-minute, 6-mile hike in
complete darkness. Juliana is one of the
students forced to take this risk.
Without access to a proper high school,
she has to do this every night while
others are forced to stay home without
an education. This is the reality for
hundreds of kids just like her in this
area and millions more all across
Mexico. So, that's why we partnered with
the Televisa Foundation to construct a
brand new school for Juliana and her
community and a brand new soccer field
so the students can stay healthy in and
outside of the classroom. Now, Juliana
can go to school every single day
safely. If you want to watch more about
how we help kids not just in Mexico, but
across the world, go watch our new
video.
